onboarding1Title: Every year, your county makes a promise
onboarding1Body: A budget line for a borehole. A market shed. A bursary fund. Money is set aside for your ward — but a line in a budget book isn't the same as water flowing from a tap.
onboarding2Body: Browse every project budgeted for your ward — roads, clinics, schools, bursaries — explained simply, in English, Kiswahili, or your local dialect.
onboarding3Title: Tell us what you actually see
onboarding3Body: Walked past that borehole? Waited at that clinic? In under a minute, say it's done, not done, or only partly there — anonymously and safely.
onboarding4Title: Nobody can quietly rewrite the record
onboarding4Body: Every report you and your neighbours submit is permanently logged to a tamper-evident ledger. Once it's in, it stays — for journalists, auditors and the county to see.
onboarding5Title: No smartphone? No signal? Still counts.
onboarding5Body: Report by WhatsApp or a simple SMS. No connection at all? Pass it to a neighbour's phone over Bluetooth — it reaches us the next time they're online.

privacyNotice: Your reports are stored under an anonymous ID, never your name. Photos have location/device data removed and GPS is only kept to neighbourhood-level precision. See Kenya's Data Protection Act 2019 and the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC, odpc.go.ke) for your rights over this data.

helpIntro: Every project shows two separate things: what the county's own document claims, and what residents have verified. They're never merged into one number, so you can always see both sides.
helpStatus_reportedBody: Either no one has reported on this project yet, or not enough independent reports have come in to confirm or dispute the county's claim.
helpStatus_confirmedBody: At least {agreeNeeded} independent residents reported the same thing, and it matches what the county's document says. "Independent" means different people — if they shared their location, more than {radiusM}m apart, so it isn't just one household reporting more than once.
helpStatus_disputedBody: At least {disagreeNeeded} independent residents reported something that disagrees with the county's claim — for example, the county says a project is complete but residents say it was never built. This doesn't say who's right; it flags that the record needs a closer look.
helpIndependenceBody: Two reports count as independent if they come from different people, and — when location was shared — more than {radiusM} metres apart. Reports with no location are always counted as independent, so residents reporting by SMS (which has no GPS) aren't penalised.
helpCountsTitle: Why do I only see "not yet verified" after I report?
helpCountsBody: One report on its own is never enough to confirm or dispute anything — that's deliberate, so a single person (or a fake account) can't flip a project's status alone. Open the project to see exactly how many more independent reports are needed.
